item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: Bugs takes a peek inside a movie theater that was built directly over his rabbit hole. Elmer and Daffy complicate matters.

item.title: Young Adult
item.description: A writer returns to her hometown to relive the old days and win back a former flame.

item.title: Bell, Book and Candle
item.description: A modern-day witch likes her neighbor but despises his fiancee, so she enchants him to love her instead...only to fall in love with him herself.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A female wildcat paints a white stripe on herself to scare a zookeeper and escape from the zoo at the Paris Exposition. Pepe LePew pursues his love, but any time he showers her with hugs and kisses the claws come out and she attacks.

item.title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
item.description: Irish revolutionary Sean Lemass and playwright Sean O'Casey involve Indy in the Easter Rebellion. Then, Indy falls for a suffragette in London.

item.title: Fractured Flickers
item.description: Hans Conried and celebrity guests present dubbed over silent picture film clips.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: Granny, Sylvester and Tweety take a trip to Hawaii, and Tweety gets left on an island guarded by a pet shark.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Spider Woman
item.description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a series of so-called "pajama suicides".

item.title: Blondie
item.description: Dagwood and Blondie play a "role reversal". Blondie minds Mr. Dither's office while Dagwood minds the house. However when Dagwood sneaks off to go fishing and gets involved with a woman whose boat overturns Blondie suspects something fishy!

item.title: Laurel and Hardy
item.description: Stan and Ollie hide in a mansion to escape from a policeman., Ollie ends up in need of a blood transfusion., Stan and Ollie do battle with inanimate objects.
